description: One call for the full workflow: prior-art search report, then the patent application draft. Async; pauses for review after the search; poll get_job. Paid: bundle ($149). Returns drafts only, not legal advice. Results must be reviewed by a registered patent attorney or patent agent.

idempotency_key.description: Your stable unique key for this request; reuse it to retry safely. Format: any non-empty string. Example: "order-7f3a-claims-1".

intake.description: Invention intake (JSON): {offer:"search|draft|bundle", CORE:{problem, solution, how_it_works, alternatives, known_art, advantages, key_elements:[{id:"E1",text,required}], inventors:[], figures:[]}, SEARCH:{keywords:[]}, date_alerts:[], open_gaps:[]}. Full schema: get_intake_schema. Check with validate_intake first.

offer.description: Optional offer to buy. Default: the lowest-priced open offer that includes this tool.

review_approval_id.description: Optional approval id issued after you review the search step; omit it and the job pauses after the search.

sku_id.description: Fixed value for this tool: "run_bundle-v1". The server sets the price.

terms_accepted.description: Set true to accept the Terms, Privacy Policy and Confidentiality and Non-Use Agreement and receive a checkout link. Example: true.

name: run_bundle
title: Search then draft (bundle)
